subject: Request: tiered evaluation top-up for head-to-head RFP
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@medisys.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Diane Kwan <diane.kwan@medisys.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: tiered evaluation top-up for head-to-head RFP

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Medisys is running a formal head-to-head as part of an RFP; the technical team wants parity in scale so we can compare Redwood vs. CobaltAI on our three exemplar pipelines (clinical note gen, triage summarization, and query-based retrieval + generation).

Current ask: would Redwood provision an additional 150,000-token evaluation allotment (30-day window) scoped to the RFP workloads? We need the tokens bound to the RDW-2027-823 trial so usage is isolated and we can export logs for our audit team.

Questions we need answered before the comparison:
- Can you guarantee identical runtime settings (seq length / temperature) and provide a perf breakdown (p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens) so the bench is apples-to-apples?
- Will Redwood commit to token expiry of 30 days (no auto-charge afterwards)?
- Any objections to us sharing a sanitized trace with the evaluation committee?

I've attached the RFP excerpt (redacted). Happy to hop on a quick sync if helpful — Diane and I are trying to close this evaluation window by next Friday.

Best,
Oliver
---
Oliver Grant
Head of ML Platforms, Medisys
oliver.grant@medisys.com
[Attachment: Medisys_RFP_excerpt.pdf (pdf)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@medisys.com>
Cc: Diane Kwan <diane.kwan@medisys.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: tiered evaluation top-up for head-to-head RFP

Hi Oliver — really appreciate the context and timeline.

Short answer: we can support this, but need to lock a small staged credit schedule and a narrow audit/export scope for the logs. Proposed quick plan (provisional until internal approvals):
- 150k tokens allocated to RDW-2027-823 for 30 days total.
- Staged release: 50k immediate, 50k after midpoint (14 days) if usage aligns, 50k final on completion.
- Token expiry enforced at 30 days, no automatic billing.
- We will provide a perf snapshot (p50/p95 latency, cost/token by model variant) and a sanitized trace export.

I’m looping in Marissa, Ben and Laura to confirm the commercial side and get approval for the staged schedule + a small benchmarking credit supplement (bounty) to offset operational costs during the head-to-head. Attaching our internal trial plan and a draft credit schedule.

Karthik
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: trial_plan_v2.pdf (pdf); credit_schedule.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Request: tiered evaluation top-up for head-to-head RFP

Team — forwarding Medisys ask. Key points: 150k tokens, 30-day window, need exportable traces and perf snapshot. I'm proposing the staged release noted below and a $5k promotional credit (applied to billed overage if they exceed tokens) as a small bounty to keep the comparison fair and friendly.

Proposed credit schedule (draft):
- Stage 1: 50k tokens + immediate sandbox access (day 0)
- Stage 2: additional 50k tokens released day 14 contingent on evidence of progress (logs)
- Stage 3: final 50k tokens released at completion or on day 25 if they hit targets
- Bonus: $5,000 account credit to apply toward post-trial consumption or to offset any short-term infra cost (applies only if they run the comparison against an approved competitor list and share sanitized traces)

Operational constraints: token allocation must be tagged to RDW-2027-823, logs delivered to Medisys S3 (sanitized), and we require an evaluation acknowledgement (one-paragraph) in return stating Redwood had parity conditions.

Please reply with: Approve / Approve with edits / Decline. If approve, include any edits to the dollar amount or gating criteria. Finance/legal sign-off will be required for the credit.

Thanks — K

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Request: tiered evaluation top-up for head-to-head RFP

Karthik — thanks for the clear plan. I support the staged 50/50/50 approach with the following edits:
- Reduce bonus from $5k to $3k; marketing can top up with a co-marketing widget if needed.
- Add explicit clause: no permanent model pinning or SLA commitments beyond the 30-day trial window.
- Require Medisys to sign a short amendment (DocuSign) that the tokens are for evaluation only and that logs will be sanitized for PII before export.

I'll approve pending quick finance confirmation on the $3k credit and legal OK on the amendment language. Ben — can you confirm finance is good for $3k at our standard evaluation promo budget and provide the billing tag we should apply?

If finance says yes, I'll ask legal to draft the one-paragraph amendment and we can send the offer to Oliver.

—Marissa
AE Team Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@medisys.com>
Cc: Diane Kwan <diane.kwan@medisys.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: tiered evaluation top-up for head-to-head RFP

Hi Oliver — quick update and confirmation:

We have internal approval to proceed with a staged 150k token allocation tied to RDW-2027-823, 30-day expiry, and the following terms:
- Stage 1: 50k tokens + sandbox access (immediate)
- Stage 2: 50k tokens (released at day 14 upon receipt of progress logs)
- Stage 3: 50k tokens (released at completion or day 25 upon milestone)
- Promotional credit: $3,000 account credit (applies only to this evaluation; marketing may add co-marketing support separately)
- Logs: we will provide a sanitized trace export; Medisys must confirm in amendment that traces will only be used for evaluation and that PII is removed
- No ongoing SLA beyond the 30-day evaluation window; no automatic renewal or billing after expiry

Action items for Medisys: please sign the short amendment (DocuSign link below) and confirm S3 export details / destination. Once signed, we’ll provision Stage 1 tokens within 24 hours.

DocuSign amendment: https://docusign.redwoodinference.com/rdw-2027-823-amend
CRM deal page: https://crm.redwoodinference.com/deals/RDW-2027-823

Happy to jump on a short call if you want to walk through gating criteria.

Thanks — Karthik
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: credit_schedule.xlsx (xlsx)]
